title: 1 Centavo

obverse.description: The Emblem of Guatemala depicts two rifles and two swords crossed with a wreath of laurel. In the middle a scroll of parchment with the words "Liberty 15 of September, 1821" and in the upper part the national bird; the Quetzal.
obverse.lettering:
REPUBLICA DE GUATEMALA
LIBERTAD
15 DE
SETIEMBRE
DE 1821
1976
obverse.lettering_translation:
Republic of Guatemala
Liberty
15th of
September,
1821

reverse.description: Denomination at top and a bust of Bartolomé de las Casas (c. 1484 – 1566).
reverse.lettering:
UN CENTAVO
FRAY BARTOLOME DE LAS CASAS

comments:
KM# 275.1 - No outlined coat. Larger portrait, date, and letters. Date with no dots.
KM# 275.2 - No outlined coat. Smaller portrait, date, and letters. Date with dots.
KM# 275.3 - No outlined coat. Smaller portrait, date, and letters. Lighter letters. Date with dots.
KM# 275.4 - Outlined coat. Smaller portrait, date, and letters. Date with dots.
KM# 275.5 - No outlined coat. Modified portrait. Larger date. Smaller letters. Lighter letters. Date with dots.



While these coins are no longer in circulation, they are still redeemable by the Bank of Guatemala for face value.
